Use this on pages that are part of the [[Quickstart guide]].

Usage:
<pre>{{Quickstart}}</pre>

Advanced usage:
<pre>
{{Quickstart
 |advanced=(Page title)
 |advanced_title=(Text to be displayed in link)
}}
</pre>

Both "advanced" parameters are optional. The <code>advanced_title</code> parameter requires the <code>advanced</code> parameter.
